description: Audits all sheets in the project and alerts the user if any sheet lacks a valid sheet number or sheet name.
edge_cases: Placeholder sheets (ViewSheet.IsPlaceholder) having empty or partial metadata
Whitespace-only strings or null values in SHEET_NUMBER or SHEET_NAME parameters
Handling document without any ViewSheet elements to avoid NullReferenceException
Excluding sheet view templates or non-standard sheets if present
